title: THE DOCKLANDS STANDOFF
description: Hundreds of demonstrators have occupied the Docklands distribution district. Police units are waiting for instructions while conflicting reports reach City Hall.

reports.statement: Commissioner Hale claims that armed organisers are preparing to attack police positions from inside the district.

revelation.title: THE ALLEGED WEAPONS
revelation.text: Independent investigators find no organised armed group inside the district. Several metal objects identified by police intelligence were construction tools and medical equipment. A small number of demonstrators carried improvised weapons, but Hale's report significantly exaggerated the threat.

reports.statement: Elena Voss reports that the suspicious crates photographed inside the occupation mostly contain food, medical supplies and protective equipment.

revelation.title: THE CONTENTS OF THE CRATES
revelation.text: Released warehouse footage confirms that most crates contained bottled water, first-aid equipment, food and protective masks. Elena's description was substantially accurate.

choices.text: Trust Hale's warning and authorise an immediate police assault.
choices.outcome: Riot police enter the district using armoured vehicles, tear gas and mass arrests. The occupation ends quickly, but reports of civilian injuries spread across the city.

choices.text: Delay police action and send independent observers into the district.
choices.outcome: Legal observers and emergency officials enter the occupied district. The delay frustrates police commanders and business leaders, but immediate violence is avoided.

choices.text: Open direct negotiations for a peaceful evacuation.
choices.outcome: Representatives from the occupation agree to talks. The district remains closed while negotiations continue, but both sides temporarily step back from confrontation.
